meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.8
§ Ephai = "gloomy"
a Netophathite, whose sons were among the captains of the forces left in Judah after the deportation to Babylon

elsewhere.note: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and…
